title: 荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘~Maeslant storm-surge barrier
focus: 浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析~Joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability
summary: 本課以荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘為入口，深入浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Maeslant storm-surge barrier as its entry point, this course examines joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 單參數敏感度：固定水線面積1200 m²及外水密度1025 kg/m³，只把新增質量由600 t降至300 t。ΔT=m/(ρA)由0.4878 m降至0.2439 m，恰為一半；此比例限小吃水變化與固定水線面積，不適用浸沒後水線形狀明顯改變的狀態。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. External moment M=Fr=480 MN·m is a global equilibrium quantity, not a pure moment carried directly by the ball joint. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For a one-parameter sensitivity comparison, hold waterplane area at 1200 m² and external density at 1025 kg/m³, reducing only added mass from 600 t to 300 t. ΔT=m/(ρA) falls from 0.4878 m to 0.2439 m, exactly half. This scaling assumes small draft changes and a constant waterplane, not substantially changed submerged geometry.
history: 馬仕朗防潮閘在鹿特丹外港航道兩岸配置大型活動門體，與哈特爾防潮閘及堤防共同形成區域防線。馬仕朗防潮閘開始建設，保留主要航道平時開放。 馬仕朗防潮閘建設完成，成為歐洲港防線的一部分。 官方記載馬仕朗防潮閘首次因風暴而關閉防護。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。~The Maeslant Barrier places large movable gates beside the Rotterdam approach waterway and works with the Hartel Barrier and dykes as a regional defence. Construction begins on the Maeslant Barrier while preserving an open main navigation route. The Maeslant Barrier is completed as part of the Europoort defence system. The owner records the first storm-protection closure of the Maeslant Barrier. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

units.anchor: 浮運吃水與壓載~Floating draft and ballast
units.title: 浮運吃水與壓載~Floating draft and ballast
units.mechanism: 中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。水線面積決定增加重量所造成的吃水變化，不能用門高直接換算沉降。 假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。 艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。若一側進水較快，剛體平均吃水模型便漏掉扭轉與局部碰撞的危險。~A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy. Waterplane area controls the draft change caused by added mass, rather than the overall gate height. Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. Unequal filling creates tilt, so a mean-draft model misses twisting and local collision hazards during the transition.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area.
units.verify: 同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。利用各艙液位推算重心移動，核對觀測傾斜方向是否符合新增壓載的位置。~Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Check added mass against displaced volume and record salinity-related external density changes separately. Infer center-of-gravity movement from individual tank levels and check that observed heel matches the added ballast location.
units.failure: 艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。若一側進水較快，剛體平均吃水模型便漏掉扭轉與局部碰撞的危險。~Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. Unequal filling creates tilt, so a mean-draft model misses twisting and local collision hazards during the transition.
units.misconception: 浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。~Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude.
units.practice: 以浮運吃水與壓載編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for floating draft and ballast, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Check added mass against displaced volume and record salinity-related external density changes separately.

units.anchor: 球鉸支臂力矩~Spherical-joint arm moment
units.title: 球鉸支臂力矩~Spherical-joint arm moment
units.mechanism: 球接頭容許多方向轉動，卻仍需把巨大門體荷載傳入陸側基礎。支臂幾何控制力矩和軸力分配，轉動自由不代表沒有反力。 假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。 將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。~A spherical joint permits rotation in several directions while transmitting gate loads into shore foundations. Arm geometry controls moment and axial-force distribution; rotational freedom does not eliminate reaction forces. Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. External moment M=Fr=480 MN·m is a global equilibrium quantity, not a pure moment carried directly by the ball joint. Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. External moment M=Fr=480 MN·m is a global equilibrium quantity, not a pure moment carried directly by the ball joint.
units.verify: 繪出門體、支臂和球鉸分別的自由體圖，再用應變與位移方向核對內力路徑；確認力臂量的是垂直距離而非桁架長度。將支臂內力重組為基礎合力，檢查向量和與外部門體水壓是否閉合。~Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint. Check load paths with strain and displacement directions, ensuring lever arm means perpendicular distance rather than truss length. Reassemble arm forces into foundation resultants and check vector closure against the externally applied gate pressure.
units.failure: 將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。~Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage.
units.misconception: 球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。~A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions.
units.practice: 以球鉸支臂力矩編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。繪出門體、支臂和球鉸分別的自由體圖，再用應變與位移方向核對內力路徑；確認力臂量的是垂直距離而非桁架長度。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for spherical-joint arm moment, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint. Check load paths with strain and displacement directions, ensuring lever arm means perpendicular distance rather than truss length.

units.anchor: 支臂壓桿穩定~Arm compression-member stability
units.title: 支臂壓桿穩定~Arm compression-member stability
units.mechanism: 細長支臂桿件可能先失穩再達材料降伏，端部拘束決定有效長度。理想歐拉式只說明幾何敏感性，實際彎曲與殘餘應力需另外處理。 假設E=200 GPa、I=0.08 m⁴、鉸支長40 m，Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN；理想直桿彈性屈曲，未含缺陷或設計折減。 節點腐蝕或鬆動會改變端部拘束，讓先前的有效長度假設失效。若只檢查材料強度，便可能漏掉受壓桿件突然出現的側向失穩。~A slender arm member can buckle before yielding, and end restraint sets effective length. Euler theory illustrates geometric sensitivity but leaves initial curvature and residual stresses to separate assessment. Assume E=200 GPa, I=0.08 m⁴ and pinned length 40 m. Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN, for an ideal straight elastic member without imperfections or design reductions. Joint corrosion or looseness changes end restraint and invalidates an earlier effective length. Checking material strength alone can miss sudden lateral instability in an otherwise apparently adequate compression member.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設E=200 GPa、I=0.08 m⁴、鉸支長40 m，Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN；理想直桿彈性屈曲，未含缺陷或設計折減。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume E=200 GPa, I=0.08 m⁴ and pinned length 40 m. Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN, for an ideal straight elastic member without imperfections or design reductions.
units.verify: 以測量所得桿件初彎曲建立幾何模型，核對節點轉動和側向支撐位置；比較不同有效長度的敏感性，不直接把理論臨界力當容許荷載。比較支點轉角和壓桿側向位移的關係，以辨認實際端部是否近似鉸接或有拘束。~Model measured initial curvature, joint rotation and lateral bracing locations. Compare sensitivity to effective length instead of treating the theoretical critical force as an allowable load. Compare support rotation with member lateral displacement to identify whether real ends approximate pins or restrained connections.
units.failure: 節點腐蝕或鬆動會改變端部拘束，讓先前的有效長度假設失效。若只檢查材料強度，便可能漏掉受壓桿件突然出現的側向失穩。~Joint corrosion or looseness changes end restraint and invalidates an earlier effective length. Checking material strength alone can miss sudden lateral instability in an otherwise apparently adequate compression member.
units.misconception: 鋼材尚未降伏時，細長受壓桿件就不可能屈曲。~A slender compression member cannot buckle before its steel yields.
units.practice: 以支臂壓桿穩定編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以測量所得桿件初彎曲建立幾何模型，核對節點轉動和側向支撐位置；比較不同有效長度的敏感性，不直接把理論臨界力當容許荷載。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for arm compression-member stability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Model measured initial curvature, joint rotation and lateral bracing locations. Compare sensitivity to effective length instead of treating the theoretical critical force as an allowable load.

units.anchor: 曲面門水壓分解~Resolving pressure on curved gates
units.title: 曲面門水壓分解~Resolving pressure on curved gates
units.mechanism: 曲面水壓應按法向分布積分，水平分量可由垂直投影求得，垂直分量則與上覆假想水體有關。曲面面積不能直接乘最大壓力。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設垂直投影寬20 m、水深5 m、單側靜水密度1025 kg/m³；水平分量ρgbh²/2=2.514 MN，未求曲面垂直分量。 把水壓視為全水平會漏掉浮沉方向荷載，影響壓載與接觸判斷。波浪使壓力隨時間和位置改變，靜水分量不能代表瞬間最大合力。~Pressure acts normal to a curved surface. Its horizontal component follows the vertical projection, while its vertical component relates to an imaginary overlying water volume; surface area times maximum pressure is inappropriate. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume vertical projection width 20 m, one-sided depth 5 m and water density 1025 kg/m³. Horizontal force ρgbh²/2=2.514 MN; the curved-surface vertical component remains separate. Treating all pressure as horizontal misses vertical loading that affects ballast and contact. Waves vary pressure in time and space, so the hydrostatic component cannot represent the maximum transient resultant.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設垂直投影寬20 m、水深5 m、單側靜水密度1025 kg/m³；水平分量ρgbh²/2=2.514 MN，未求曲面垂直分量。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume vertical projection width 20 m, one-sided depth 5 m and water density 1025 kg/m³. Horizontal force ρgbh²/2=2.514 MN; the curved-surface vertical component remains separate.
units.verify: 分別畫水平與垂直投影，對照多點壓力計積分與結構反力；若潮水淹過門頂或兩側皆有水，須更新濕潤邊界再計算。以相同水位的獨立積分重算垂直分量，確認水平投影沒有被當成全部濕潤面。~Draw separate horizontal and vertical projections, comparing integrated pressure measurements with reactions. Revise wetted boundaries whenever water overtops the gate or occupies both sides. Independently integrate the vertical component at matching levels and verify that projected area is not mistaken for wetted area.
units.failure: 把水壓視為全水平會漏掉浮沉方向荷載，影響壓載與接觸判斷。波浪使壓力隨時間和位置改變，靜水分量不能代表瞬間最大合力。~Treating all pressure as horizontal misses vertical loading that affects ballast and contact. Waves vary pressure in time and space, so the hydrostatic component cannot represent the maximum transient resultant.
units.misconception: 曲面門體的靜水壓合力永遠只有水平方向分量。~Hydrostatic loading on a curved gate always has only a horizontal component.
units.practice: 以曲面門水壓分解編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。分別畫水平與垂直投影，對照多點壓力計積分與結構反力；若潮水淹過門頂或兩側皆有水，須更新濕潤邊界再計算。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for resolving pressure on curved gates, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Draw separate horizontal and vertical projections, comparing integrated pressure measurements with reactions. Revise wetted boundaries whenever water overtops the gate or occupies both sides.

units.anchor: 自由液面穩定修正~Free-surface stability correction
units.title: 自由液面穩定修正~Free-surface stability correction
units.mechanism: 未滿的壓載艙在傾斜時移動液體重心，降低初始復原能力。相同水量分裝在窄艙或集中於寬艙，穩定效果可以不同。 假設艙液密度1000 kg/m³、自由液面慣性矩8000 m⁴、總排水質量20 million kg，虛擬重心升高ρI/m=0.4 m，限小傾角。 部分充水的過渡階段可能比空艙或滿艙更不利。若把隔板當成密閉分艙而實際有大開孔，計算會低估液體轉移和動態晃蕩。~Partially filled ballast tanks move the liquid center of gravity during heel and reduce initial stability. Equal water volumes distributed among narrow tanks or one wide tank can have different effects. Assume tank-liquid density 1000 kg/m³, free-surface second moment 8000 m⁴ and displacement mass 20 million kg. Virtual center-of-gravity rise ρI/m=0.4 m, for small heel. An intermediate filling stage may be less stable than empty or full tanks. Treating perforated baffles as sealed subdivisions understates liquid transfer and dynamic sloshing across the available free surface.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設艙液密度1000 kg/m³、自由液面慣性矩8000 m⁴、總排水質量20 million kg，虛擬重心升高ρI/m=0.4 m，限小傾角。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume tank-liquid density 1000 kg/m³, free-surface second moment 8000 m⁴ and displacement mass 20 million kg. Virtual center-of-gravity rise ρI/m=0.4 m, for small heel.
units.verify: 以艙形與液位算自由液面慣性矩，核對隔板是否真正限制橫向流動；將傾角資料對應每個充水階段，而非只看最初和最終狀態。在圖面標出每個可連通液面，依真正連通寬度重算慣性矩而不是依名義隔間。~Calculate free-surface moments from tank shape and level, checking whether baffles actually restrict transverse flow. Relate heel measurements to each filling stage rather than only initial and final conditions. Mark communicating liquid surfaces on drawings and recalculate their moments using actual connected widths rather than nominal subdivisions.
units.failure: 部分充水的過渡階段可能比空艙或滿艙更不利。若把隔板當成密閉分艙而實際有大開孔，計算會低估液體轉移和動態晃蕩。~An intermediate filling stage may be less stable than empty or full tanks. Treating perforated baffles as sealed subdivisions understates liquid transfer and dynamic sloshing across the available free surface.
units.misconception: 壓載艙半滿一定比空艙或全滿時更穩定。~A half-full ballast tank is always more stable than an empty or full tank.
units.practice: 以自由液面穩定修正編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以艙形與液位算自由液面慣性矩，核對隔板是否真正限制橫向流動；將傾角資料對應每個充水階段，而非只看最初和最終狀態。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for free-surface stability correction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calculate free-surface moments from tank shape and level, checking whether baffles actually restrict transverse flow. Relate heel measurements to each filling stage rather than only initial and final conditions.

units.anchor: 沉放前底隙流量~Under-gate flow before seating
units.title: 沉放前底隙流量~Under-gate flow before seating
units.mechanism: 閘門接近底床時，剩餘狹縫承受水位差並形成高速流。縮小間隙可能降低總流量卻提高局部梯度，對沉積物與門體振動產生不同作用。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設狹縫寬30 m、高0.2 m、壓差水頭1 m、Cd=0.65；Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=17.27 m³/s，僅為穩定孔口近似。 底床殘留砂石會使間隙不均，形成集中噴流與不對稱支承。若把單一水位差當作整條狹縫的條件，可能漏判局部氣蝕或振動區域。~As a gate approaches the sill, the remaining slot carries the head difference and forms a jet. A smaller gap may reduce discharge while increasing local gradients, affecting sediment and vibration differently. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume slot width 30 m, height 0.2 m, head difference 1 m and Cd=0.65. Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=17.27 m³/s, a steady-orifice approximation only. Debris creates uneven gaps, concentrated jets and asymmetric contact. Assigning one head difference uniformly along the slot may miss localized cavitation or vibration zones near changing sill geometry.

units.misconception: 總漏流減小就表示所有閘底局部流速都同時減小。~Reduced total leakage means every local under-gate velocity also decreases.

Compare gap geometry, head and local acoustic velocities, checking how the discharge coefficient varies with position. units.anchor: 止水縫漏流診斷~Seal leakage diagnosis
units.title: 止水縫漏流診斷~Seal leakage diagnosis
units.mechanism: 止水縫的漏流同時受縫寬、壓差和變形控制，漏水量增大不一定是橡膠老化。以同水頭比較流量，可先排除水位改變造成的表面趨勢。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設長10 m、縫寬2 mm、Cd=0.6、Δh=3 m；Q=0.6×0.02√(2×9.81×3)=0.09206 m³/s，均勻縫且無黏性修正。 小縫中的黏性流可能不遵守孔口平方根關係，不能把正規化曲線偏移全歸於磨耗。雜物卡縫與門體歪斜也會產生相似漏水訊號。~Seal leakage depends on gap, head and deformation, so increased flow does not necessarily indicate rubber ageing. Comparing at equal head first removes water-level changes that can imitate deterioration. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume length 10 m, gap 2 mm, Cd=0.6 and head 3 m. Q=0.6×0.02√(2×9.81×3)=0.09206 m³/s, for a uniform slot without viscous correction. Viscous flow through a very narrow gap may not follow the orifice square-root law. Debris and gate misalignment can imitate wear, so normalized curve changes do not uniquely identify material deterioration.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設長10 m、縫寬2 mm、Cd=0.6、Δh=3 m；Q=0.6×0.02√(2×9.81×3)=0.09206 m³/s，均勻縫且無黏性修正。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume length 10 m, gap 2 mm, Cd=0.6 and head 3 m. Q=0.6×0.02√(2×9.81×3)=0.09206 m³/s, for a uniform slot without viscous correction.
units.verify: 以漏流除水頭平方根作初步正規化，再核對門位、溫度與止水接觸痕；用分區集水找出漏流位置，保留每次比較的潮向。對相同水頭的重複試驗比較流量斜率，並以密封接觸影像區分縫寬改變和雜物卡塞。~Normalize leakage initially by square root of head, then compare position, temperature and contact marks. Locate leakage using sectional collection while retaining the tidal direction for each comparison. Compare repeated flow-head slopes at equal heads and use contact imagery to distinguish gap growth from trapped debris.
units.failure: 小縫中的黏性流可能不遵守孔口平方根關係，不能把正規化曲線偏移全歸於磨耗。雜物卡縫與門體歪斜也會產生相似漏水訊號。~Viscous flow through a very narrow gap may not follow the orifice square-root law. Debris and gate misalignment can imitate wear, so normalized curve changes do not uniquely identify material deterioration.
units.misconception: 漏流增加就足以證明止水橡膠老化，無須檢查水頭。~Increasing leakage proves seal ageing without checking the head difference.
units.practice: 以止水縫漏流診斷編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以漏流除水頭平方根作初步正規化，再核對門位、溫度與止水接觸痕；用分區集水找出漏流位置，保留每次比較的潮向。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for seal leakage diagnosis, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Normalize leakage initially by square root of head, then compare position, temperature and contact marks. Locate leakage using sectional collection while retaining the tidal direction for each comparison.

units.anchor: 共同原因與備援~Common cause and redundancy
units.title: 共同原因與備援~Common cause and redundancy
units.mechanism: 兩套備援設備若共用電源、機房或感測來源，就不是完全獨立。風暴可能同時破壞多條功能鏈，可靠度計算必須把共同原因與單機失效分開。 假設兩單元各獨立失效機率0.02，共同原因機率0.005；簡化總失效q=0.005+0.995×0.02²=0.005398，非本站實測可靠度。 將共用電纜路徑的兩套系統視為獨立會大幅低估失效。備援設備即使定期空載測試合格，也未必能在淹水、斷電和高荷載同時出現時接替。~Redundant equipment sharing power, rooms or sensing is not fully independent. One storm may damage several functional chains, requiring common-cause events to be separated from individual equipment failures. Assume independent unit-failure probabilities 0.02 and common-cause probability 0.005. Simplified total q=0.005+0.995×0.02²=0.005398, not a measured site reliability. Treating two systems in one cable route as independent understates failure. Successful unloaded backup tests do not prove takeover during simultaneous flooding, power loss and high mechanical demand.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩單元各獨立失效機率0.02，共同原因機率0.005；簡化總失效q=0.005+0.995×0.02²=0.005398，非本站實測可靠度。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent unit-failure probabilities 0.02 and common-cause probability 0.005. Simplified total q=0.005+0.995×0.02²=0.005398, not a measured site reliability.
units.verify: 逐項追蹤電源、冷卻、網路、感測和維修狀態的共用節點，用演練事件核對是否真正隔離；將假設獨立的理由寫入失效樹。追查演練中兩套設備同時失去功能的事件，確認共同原因沒有被拆成兩件獨立故障。~Trace shared power, cooling, network, sensing and maintenance dependencies. Use exercise events to verify actual separation and document the justification for each independence assumption in the fault tree. Trace exercise events that disabled both units and ensure one common cause was not counted as two independent failures.
units.failure: 將共用電纜路徑的兩套系統視為獨立會大幅低估失效。備援設備即使定期空載測試合格，也未必能在淹水、斷電和高荷載同時出現時接替。~Treating two systems in one cable route as independent understates failure. Successful unloaded backup tests do not prove takeover during simultaneous flooding, power loss and high mechanical demand.
units.misconception: 設備數量加倍就能直接把整體失效機率平方。~Doubling equipment automatically squares the complete system failure probability.
units.practice: 以共同原因與備援編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。逐項追蹤電源、冷卻、網路、感測和維修狀態的共用節點，用演練事件核對是否真正隔離；將假設獨立的理由寫入失效樹。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for common cause and redundancy, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Trace shared power, cooling, network, sensing and maintenance dependencies. Use exercise events to verify actual separation and document the justification for each independence assumption in the fault tree.

units.anchor: 資料延遲與判斷鏈~Data latency in decisions
units.title: 資料延遲與判斷鏈~Data latency in decisions
units.mechanism: 自動判斷取決於資料的新鮮度、時鐘與品質旗標，畫面顯示合理水位仍可能是舊值。將取樣延遲和運算時間分開，才能定位錯誤。 假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。 重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。多站同時延遲不能被誤當成一致的高品質證據。~Automated decisions depend on data age, synchronized clocks and quality flags. A plausible displayed water level may be stale, so sampling latency must be separated from computation time to diagnose the chain. Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min. Uncompensated difference is 0.48 m, a short-term linear illustration rather than a storm-surge forecast. Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. Replacing measurement time with arrival time conceals this defect, and several equally delayed stations do not constitute independent high-quality confirmation.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min. Uncompensated difference is 0.48 m, a short-term linear illustration rather than a storm-surge forecast.
units.verify: 在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。以原始量測時間重排事件，核對資料更新旗標能否辨識通訊恢復後抵達的過期讀數。~In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records. Verify traceable quality flags and distinguish transmission errors from estimation errors. Reorder events by measurement time and verify that freshness flags identify stale readings arriving after communications recover.
units.failure: 重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。多站同時延遲不能被誤當成一致的高品質證據。~Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. Replacing measurement time with arrival time conceals this defect, and several equally delayed stations do not constitute independent high-quality confirmation.
units.misconception: 多個測站讀數一致就能證明資料沒有過時問題。~Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale.
units.practice: 以資料延遲與判斷鏈編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for data latency in decisions, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records. Verify traceable quality flags and distinguish transmission errors from estimation errors.

units.anchor: 荷載循環與疲勞累積~Load cycles and fatigue accumulation
units.title: 荷載循環與疲勞累積~Load cycles and fatigue accumulation
units.mechanism: 大型活動結構除風暴荷載外也承受測試與維修循環。疲勞累積依應力範圍分組，小幅循環數量多也可能有影響，但線性損傷和忽略序列只是近似。 假設兩組循環n1=2000、N1=100000與n2=300、N2=10000，Miner和D=0.02+0.03=0.05；N值為假設，不作剩餘年限預測。 小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。若只記錄關閘次數而未量應力範圍，也無法建立可靠疲勞譜。~Moving structures experience test and maintenance cycles as well as storms. Fatigue accumulation groups stress ranges; many smaller cycles may matter, but linear damage and sequence independence remain approximations. Assume cycle groups n1=2000, N1=100000 and n2=300, N2=10000. Miner sum D=0.02+0.03=0.05. Assumed capacities do not predict remaining calendar life. A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life. Closure counts alone cannot establish a fatigue spectrum without stress ranges.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩組循環n1=2000、N1=100000與n2=300、N2=10000，Miner和D=0.02+0.03=0.05；N值為假設，不作剩餘年限預測。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume cycle groups n1=2000, N1=100000 and n2=300, N2=10000. Miner sum D=0.02+0.03=0.05. Assumed capacities do not predict remaining calendar life.
units.verify: 從局部應變時間史辨認循環範圍，核對焊縫細節和腐蝕狀態；將不同運動模式分開計數，並以裂紋檢查挑戰無損傷的計算假設。以局部應變循環重新分箱計數，將雨流計數所得範圍與所用疲勞細節曲線一致對應。~Identify stress cycles from local strain histories and check weld detail and corrosion condition. Count movement modes separately and use crack inspection to challenge the calculation assumption of an intact detail. Rebin local strain cycles and consistently match rainflow stress ranges to the selected fatigue-detail curve.
units.failure: 小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。若只記錄關閘次數而未量應力範圍，也無法建立可靠疲勞譜。~A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life. Closure counts alone cannot establish a fatigue spectrum without stress ranges.
units.misconception: 累積疲勞損傷小於一就能保證構件永久安全無裂紋。~A fatigue damage sum below one guarantees permanent crack-free safety.
units.practice: 以荷載循環與疲勞累積編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從局部應變時間史辨認循環範圍，核對焊縫細節和腐蝕狀態；將不同運動模式分開計數，並以裂紋檢查挑戰無損傷的計算假設。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for load cycles and fatigue accumulation, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Identify stress cycles from local strain histories and check weld detail and corrosion condition. Count movement modes separately and use crack inspection to challenge the calculation assumption of an intact detail.
